subject: AWS metering integration: preflight questions and go-live runbook
messages:
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@stratusai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stratusai.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 14:03:00 +0000
Subject: AWS metering integration: preflight questions and go-live window

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week — StratusAI is excited about moving our SaaS listing to AWS Marketplace. We're lining up procurement and engineering to hit a target go-live the week of Oct 18. Before we lock dates, procurement has a few preflight questions on metering and fulfillment so we can sign the amended SaaS contract: 

- Entitlement mapping: we need confirmation that a single Stratus customer account will map to one entitlement key in the Marketplace and that seat/usage deltas are reportable at hourly granularity.
- Webhook durability: what's Redwood's retry/backoff policy for usage publishing and how do you surface failed posts in the Console?
- Billing reconciliation: sample payloads and the reconciliation cadence (daily invoice vs. monthly ledger).
- SLA/credits: procurement wants a short note on how outages that affect usage reporting are handled for billing adjustments.

I've attached our metering spec (Stratus_Metering_Specs.xlsx) that shows our expected metrics. Can we schedule a 45-min call this week with your billing and integration leads? Prefer Thurs 10/7 or Fri 10/8 in the morning PST.

Also, legal will route a small set of redlines for the SaaS addendum — I'll bring those to the call so we can triage.

Quick ask: please loop in whoever owns Marketplace fulfillment and anyone from legal who needs to review entitlement wording.

Thanks,
Lina Torres
Head of Partnerships, StratusAI
Lina.Torres@stratusai.com
Attachment: Stratus_Metering_Specs.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@stratusai.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 18:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AWS metering integration: preflight questions and go-live window

Hi Lina — great to hear and thanks for the spec. Looping in the folks who will own each area so we can cover everything on a call: Ben (billing ops) for reconciliation and SLA language, Olga (legal) for contract redlines, and Dev (integration) for webhooks/entitlement behavior.

Short answers up front:
- Entitlement mapping: we can map 1:1 per customer account and provide usage deltas; our ingestion supports sub-hourly reporting but Marketplace aggregation is hourly — we'll share a mapping template.
- Webhook durability: Redwood retries with exponential backoff for 72 hours and surfaces failed deliveries in the Console under Integrations -> Webhook Health. We also provide an event replay endpoint.
- Billing recon: our standard is daily usage export + monthly invoice; custom cadence can be negotiated in Dedicated/enterprise contracts.
- SLA/credits: we include a clause for reporting delays that affect billing; credit calculations are pro-rata and require evidence of missed exports.

Proposed next steps:
1) 45-min technical + procurement call: Thu 2027-10-07 17:00 UTC (10am PDT) — please confirm.
2) We'll prepare a short runbook for the call covering entitlement mapping, webhook retry charts, and a sample reconciliation report.
3) Olga, please expect the redlines; if legal prefers to send directly to Lina, that's fine.

I'm attaching our internal intake checklist so we have a shared agenda.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: StratusAI MPX preflight — action items before Thu call (internal)

Team — prep notes ahead of the call with Stratus on Thu (10/7 17:00 UTC):

Checklist (owners):
- Ben: generate a sample reconciliation report (CSV) that mirrors Marketplace invoice rows; include column definitions and rounding rules. Include a brief note about invoice lead times and typical mismatch resolution window.
- Dev: confirm webhook retry policy details and whether we can add an alert to webhook failures per-customer. Provide the sample usage payload and an event replay example. If there are any known edge-cases for high-cardinality metrics, flag them.
- Olga: expect to receive redlines from Stratus legal; please prioritize the entitlement and billing sections and flag any language that could expand our liability. Draft a short clause for credit calculation tied to missed usage exports.
- Mina: I'll build the runbook and a one-page SLA summary to share on the call.

Attachments to circulate before call: SaaS_Contract_Redlines_v3.pdf (if legal sends) and the sample recon CSV. Ben — can you have the sample by Wed EOD UTC? Dev — can you validate the sample payload and expiry/replay window by Wed?

Thanks — we'll keep this tight (45 min) and drive to agreement on the redline owners and go-live gating items.

Mina

Attachment: Internal_Preflight_Checklist.md (internal)

From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@stratusai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stratusai.com, aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 15:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: AWS metering integration: preflight questions and go-live window

Mina — thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping the right folks. Thu 10/7 17:00 UTC works for us; procurement confirms they will have the redlines ready to discuss.

Two quick notes before the call:
- Procurement expects to sign the SaaS addendum by Oct 15 so our Marketplace listing can be enabled during the Oct 18 week go-live. If any gating items remain after the call, please list them and we'll prioritize.
- AWS Marketplace has asked us to provide a single sample day of usage and a reconciliation CSV for their validation team; I'll upload those to the Drive folder linked here prior to the call.

See you on Thu.

Best,
Lina
Head of Partnerships, StratusAI
Attachment: (will upload sample day + recon CSV to Drive)
